name: aws_s3_local_gateway
description: A zero-cost, sovereign local-first S3 compatible storage gateway and bucket emulator that eliminates AWS dev costs and rate-limit latency.
rationale: Identified via live market scan: boto3 is the #1 trending package, but developers face cloud latency, network flakiness, and AWS billing overhead during local development and testing.
goals: Provide an in-memory & local disk-backed S3 compatible object store interface
Support PutObject, GetObject, ListObjectsV2, and DeleteObject with SHA256 integrity validation
Zero external cloud dependencies (runs 100% locally and offline)
Comprehensive automated pytest coverage with edge-case and idempotency tests
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
